relations.subject: Lhundub Sopa
relations.evidence: He became a novice monk and entered Gaden Chokor Monastery in 1932.

relations.subject: Lhundub Sopa
relations.evidence: In 1941, he joined Sera Monastery in Lhasa... In 1962, he was awarded the degree of Lharampa Geshe.

relations.subject: Lhundub Sopa
relations.role: Emeritus Professor in the Department of South Asian Studies
relations.evidence: In 1967, Sopa was invited by Richard Robinson to join the faculty of the pioneer Buddhist Studies Program at the University of Wisconsin–Madison... when he retired in 1997, he became Emeritus Professor
